The study population consisted of drug users with injecting use in the last 12 months who attend low-threshold drug help centres or substitution practices. Drug users attending these facilities for the sole purpose of participating in the study were also included. Pilot study in Berlin (n=146) and six Bavarian cities: Augsburg (n=81), Munich (n=108), Nuremberg (n=79), Regensburg (n=175), Ingolstadt (n=4), Würzburg (n=3).      REFERENCE: Zimmermann R, Krings A, Steffen G (2023): DRUCK 2.0-Pilot - DRUCK 2.0 - Pilotierung eines Surveillancesystems zu durch Blut und sexuell übertragenen Infektionen bei Drogengebrauchenden.
